data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.headline: Island Battles Intensify; Attrition Fronts Stalemate
previous_model_summary.war_summary: Since the last edition the island sectors have erupted anew: Dead Lands, silent for hours, logged three ownership flips in the past two hours with the latest at 23:25 UTC, while Farranac Coast added three captures by 23:43 UTC around Mara, Scythe and Terra, pushing its day‑total to fifteen. Godcrofts likewise turned over two bases at 23:43 UTC near Lipsia and Argosa, raising its 24‑hour count to eleven. Fishermans Row’s most recent turnover came at 22:10 UTC, leaving its daily tally at eleven, and Tempest Island’s activity has tapered after a burst of six captures ending at 18:36 UTC. Lykos Isle and Stlican Shelf have seen no fresh flips since 16:10 UTC and 18:52 UTC respectively, keeping their day‑long totals at twenty‑five and three. Meanwhile the high‑casualty corridors — Weathered Expanse, Callahans Passage, Kings Cage, Marban Hollow, Loch Mor, Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle — continue to bleed on both sides with accelerating losses but no strategic‑base changes, the map still favouring Colonials on the western and southern arcs and Wardens to the north and east.
